name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5
description: NIST Special Publication 800-53 — Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations. The gold standard for federal information systems security.

controls.title: Access Control Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, disseminate, and review/update an access control policy and procedures.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Manage information system accounts, including establishing, activating, modifying, reviewing, disabling, and removing accounts.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration requirements, and implementation guidance for remote access.

controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness
controls.description: Provide basic security and privacy literacy training to system users as part of initial training for new users.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: Review and analyze system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: Protect audit information and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Information Exchange
controls.description: Approve and manage the exchange of information between the system and other systems using agreements.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Develop a system-level continuous monitoring strategy and implement continuous monitoring.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control a current baseline configuration of the system.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: Configure the system to provide only essential capabilities and prohibit or restrict the use of functions, ports, protocols, software, and services not required.

controls.title: System Backup
controls.description: Conduct backups of user-level and system-level information and system documentation.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Manage system authenticators and verify the identity of the user, device, or service receiving the authenticator.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Implement an incident handling capability for incidents that includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.

controls.title: System Security and Privacy Plans
controls.description: Develop, document, and distribute a security and privacy plan that describes the security and privacy controls in place or planned.

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: Develop and implement an enterprise-wide strategy for managing risk to organizational operations and assets.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Conduct a risk assessment that includes a threat and vulnerability analysis of systems.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.description: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities are identified.

controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.description: Require the developer of the system to create and implement a security assessment plan.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information system flaws; test software and firmware updates related to flaw remediation.

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks, and unauthorized connections.
